query: What are the four categories of GSA AI use cases?
response:
Part 1:  
The four categories of GSA AI use cases are Capability Assessment, GSA Pre-Approved Application, Research and Development, and Production or Production-Intent use cases.  

Part 2:  
GSA’s AI Safety Team independently adjudicates these four types of AI use cases as part of the agency’s governance process. Capability Assessment use cases typically involve early-stage evaluations of AI capabilities. GSA Pre-Approved Application and Research and Development categories cover vetted tools and exploratory or experimental efforts, respectively. Production or Production-Intent use cases are those being deployed operationally and require additional review and approval, including by the Chief AI Officer and, for high‑impact cases, escalation to the EDGE Board.
ground_truth: Familiarization, Pre-acquisition, Research & Development, Production / Production-intent.
